title: Spatiotemporal Annotator whole-pen broiler clip
description: A pinned 19.4-second real-camera reference clip showing 40 week-one broilers across two complete pens from an overhead camera. This is the team-reviewed clip cam1__20250930_095000 from the Spatiotemporal Annotator examples. The binary is fetched into the ignored runtime home and verified against this manifest before the dashboard serves it.
attribution: cam1__20250930_095000.mp4 from the Spatiotemporal Annotator example data by Ziyuan Zhao, Texas A&M University Department of Poultry Science, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Trial approved under IACUC 2024-0108.
limitations: not spatially aligned with simulated birds
two pens share one frame rather than one isolated pen
5 fps and 848 x 480 resolution limit fine appearance and feces inspection
the source package includes human activity annotations and detector tracks, but this dashboard asset serves only the raw video bytes
